headline: A red mute light and a calmer ring

items.title: Mute you can see
items.text: While the Q is muted, the light in the middle of the dome now glows red, whatever theme you have chosen.

items.title: The ring follows quiet music
items.text: The light ring no longer flickers between the music and its idle glow during quiet passages, and it keeps the beat better.

items.title: USB audio stops cleanly
items.text: When a computer stops playing over USB, the Q no longer runs a processor core flat out, and it is ready the moment playback resumes.
